title: How your donation helps us keep showing up
fullCapacityNote: $272,120 a year funds a four-person team, including two additional full-time Peer Specialist / Case Manager positions at $60,000 each. About $150,000 a year sustains BFF at its current staffing level.
footnotes: Volunteer labor is based on about 424 recorded volunteer hours at Tuesday outreach events in 2024, valued at Colorado's current estimated value of volunteer time. Friday hours are not included.
$500 buys 37 ten-ride RTD pass books, at least 370 rides. Passes are valid for three hours and may include transfers.

items.name: Meals
items.what: Purchased food fills the gaps in donated food, so we can serve about 458 meals each month. Donated food added another $24,114 in value in 2024.

items.name: Personal care supplies
items.what: About 11,360 hygiene, first-aid and personal care items each year. In-kind gifts keep our average cost to about $0.27 per item.

items.name: Outreach infrastructure
items.what: The staff time and licensed kitchen it takes to source, prepare, haul, set up, serve and clean up two outreach events every week. Volunteers add at least $16,959 in labor.

items.name: RTD bus passes
items.what: At least 370 rides a month to appointments, food banks, shelter and services. We buy passes at a 50% nonprofit discount.

items.name: Laundry vouchers
items.what: Twenty vouchers a month, so people can reuse clothing, blankets and sleeping bags.

items.name: Daily peer outreach and resource navigation
items.what: Current resource information and partner relationships, personal navigation, Coordinated Entry and housing assessments, and warm handoffs to providers.

items.name: Peer case management
items.what: Individualized support, housing and other advocacy, coordination, problem-solving and follow-through toward goals people set for themselves.

items.name: Mobile service and direct costs
items.what: Keeps the team mobile and covers the small costs that remove barriers: IDs, documents, application fees.
